Blind spots

A page built out of the things Sentinel does not perceive. Two ordinary controls are included so the ratio has a numerator.

0 — ordinary controls (these ARE perceived)

Real link

1 — clickable, but outside the 7-token selector

div with onclick
span with tabindex
contenteditable field
role=menuitem
role=switch

Expected: unseen.outside_selector = 5.

2 — a control drawn on a canvas

Expected: opaque.canvas = 1. The button inside it is counted by nothing.

3 — a CLOSED shadow root

Expected: opaque.shadow_roots_closed = 1. The button inside is counted by nothing — we cannot count what we cannot enter, and pretending otherwise is what a flattering denominator does.

4 — a virtualised list

500 logical rows, only the visible slice is in the DOM. Expected: no audit key moves — this is a blind spot the tool cannot even size.

5 — perceived, but not on screen

Both are perceived and both report visible: false; neither is a blind spot. They raise seen, so they also keep the ratio honest.
